report_name: Astrana Health Data Breach Caused by Social Engineering Attack

threat_actors.name: Unnamed Social Engineering Actors
threat_actors.description: A threat group that conducted a targeted social engineering campaign against Astrana Health, using vishing and phone number spoofing to impersonate company personnel and gain unauthorized system access.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Voice
attack_patterns.description: Attackers used voice communication (vishing) combined with phone number spoofing, including Astrana's own corporate number, to impersonate company personnel and manipulate employees into providing system access.

attack_patterns.name: Impersonation
attack_patterns.description: Threat actors pretended to be company personnel during phone calls to trick employees into granting unauthorized access to internal systems.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
attack_patterns.description: The attackers successfully acquired and transferred an unspecified amount of 'private and confidential information' off the network after gaining access.

identities.name: Astrana Health
identities.description: A California-based healthcare management technology company that disclosed a data breach resulting from a social engineering attack.

identities.name: Astrana Health Management, Inc.
identities.description: A subsidiary of Astrana Health that was the specific target of the social engineering attack. It is responsible for sensitive back-office functions like billing and claims processing.
